# Simulator launchd jobs kept from starting at boot (`simctl boot --disabledJob=<label>`).
# A new device's first boot runs these for many minutes: lock-screen posters, photo and media
# analysis, search, Siri, widgets and the like. They held our runner busy enough that, after boot,
# installing took 163 s and single screenshots up to 15 s (docs/research/fast-simulator-screenshots.md).
# The demo uses none of them. Never list SpringBoard: the status bar override needs it.
# Labels as found in gatefold's list (iOS's own launchd job names): https://github.com/ourostack/gatefold/blob/98d7867f86b5d5f4e9dc28c652cd45a48a363d1d/.github/scripts/quiet-sim.labels
